answer: Hold every agent's payout in escrow for 30 days and pull 2% of each epoch's answers for a deep audit. A flagged answer burns that agent's escrow plus a 300 POA bond. A farm of 1,000 clones stakes 300,000 POA, and since the clones share one quill, their near-identical texts cluster: one audit hit links the set and slashes all of them. A gale of cheap accounts only multiplies exposure. A good record is a relic that can't be bought back after a slash. Caveat: auditors must post bonds too.
